comparison_policy: V3 formal evidence remains the immutable baseline.
V4 is compared with V3 at matching 100K and 500K scales.
Report storage, capture, verification, end-to-end latency, and paired confidence intervals.
A V4 PASS authorizes its measurements even if a latency component does not improve.
No measurement or threshold may be changed after viewing the formal results.
scientific_boundary: Single source and one unique, non-null, unmasked STRING key.
Output identity is the visible result digest plus zero-based row ordinal.
Join, Aggregate, SpatialJoin, composite keys, and non-STRING keys remain unsupported.
